notes.title: Introducing: Z.O.N.A Origin
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39712712/17abb5231fac8da07f6e779f179c57f910a1c504.jpg[/img]

We are excited to announce that Z.O.N.A Origin, a new game in the Z.O.N.A universe, is scheduled for release on August 26th this year. This unique VR action game combines elements of horror, survival, and RPG in a dark post-apocalyptic world.

[h2]Explore the Mysterious Zone[/h2]
Welcome to the post-apocalyptic world of Z.O.N.A Origin. Immerse yourself in the mysterious territory surrounding the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant, where incredible phenomena and deadly threats have emerged since the 2022 disaster.

[previewyoutube=5qB0-I6PEl0;full][/previewyoutube]

Explore anomalies that hide priceless artifacts and fight against mutants and bandits trying to seize the Zone's treasures. Various factions and stalkers pursue their own goals, creating a unique atmosphere of survival struggle.

[h2]A Captivating Storyline[/h2]
In 2030, the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone has become the epicenter of mysterious events. Powerful flashes have been seen in the northern Zone, and the secret government organization O.S.Z sent a team of scientists there, but they disappeared without a trace. Many stalkers tried to solve this mystery, but they all vanished.

Anomalous activity in the Zone is increasing: powerful psi-fields and new mutants appear. Experienced stalkers are convinced that mysterious processes are occurring in the northern Zone, creating anomalies and artifacts. It is believed that if this is not stopped, the Zone will destroy all life on Earth. You must head north to uncover this mystery and save humanity.

[b]Add Z.O.N.A Origin to your wishlist so you don’t miss the launch and dive into this thrilling world of adventure.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2539520/ZONA_Origin/

notes.title: Released a new game Z.O.N.A Project X VR
notes.notes:
We have released a new game in early access for VR devices: Z.O.N.A Project X.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39712712/37d9ea671a5332649ff0a113b1001801ec6f4e07.png[/img]

Z.O.N.A Project X is not just a game; it's a full immersion into the harsh world of apocalypse where every choice you make can be crucial. A diverse post-apocalyptic world, unpredictable plot, realistic handling of weapons, and dangerous anomalies - all of this awaits you in this thrilling game.

notes.title: Big Update 2.00
notes.notes:
- Significantly improved game performance even on slower PCs.
- Added support for 64-Bit mode.
- Increased player turn speed.
- Fixed bugs with physics at some levels.
- Fixed failures when using teleports in rare cases.
- And much more.

notes.title: Update version 1.01
notes.notes:
- Improve game performance. 
- Fixed smooth rotation if you are not in the center of the play area. 
- Fixed a problem with picking up some notes. 
- Other fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Corrected the smooth movement of the player. (VR locomotion)
notes.notes:
[b]U.P2[/b] Corrected the smooth movement of the player. Added the ability to move with the stick to the right and left.

[b]U.P1[/b] At the request of the players, smooth movement and running have been added to the game. But we also left the possibility of teleports. On the Valve Index, these are the Trackpad buttons, on the Oculus, the Y and B buttons on the Vive, pressing the right Trackpad in the center will activate the teleport. The light from the flashlight has also been redesigned.
